messages:
From: Jill Tran <jill.tran@novacare.com>
To: ava_chen@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-21T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: SIG3/CAIQ — ephemeral custody & segmentation evidence request

Hi Ava,

Thanks for taking this — Novacare's audit team is running through our SIG/CAIQ crosswalk and we need a narrowly scoped set of artifacts to close the custody/residency questions on your ephemeral stores. Specifically we need: 

- A short CSV mapping of any ephemeral KV / cache providers (provider name, service id, region, residency classification (customer-data/no-customer-data), and whether keys are customer-specific or shared).
- A diagram showing logical data-segmentation between tenant data and platform telemetry (PDF ok).
- The retention/purge policy that applies to ephemeral caches and a note on whether snapshots/backups are ever taken.
- Answers to two SIG rows about ephemeral provider access controls (we can take these in an XLSX).

Can you send these by EOD Monday (Nov 22)? If you have an internal runbook or a brief clarification call we can do that instead.

Appreciate it —
Jill
Jill Tran
Sr. Compliance Manager, Novacare
Audit Team: audit-team@novacare.com

From: ava_chen@redwood.com
To: Jill Tran <jill.tran@novacare.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-21T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SIG3/CAIQ — ephemeral custody & segmentation evidence request

Thanks Jill — putting a small delivery packet together. Quick notes / plan: 

- We can provide the KV mapping CSV and segmentation PDF as requested. Attaching the CSV will contain provider FQDNs and region tags; sensitive internal hostnames will be redacted.
- For retention/purge: Redwood uses ephemeral caches for inference KV (per-call or per-session) and those caches are configured to TTL-expire; we will produce the exact TTL policy and a brief note on snapshot policy (short answer: no backups by default; snapshots required only for debugging with ops approval).
- For the SIG rows, kimberly has the canonical answers; she'll draft the XLSX.

Action items: 
1) Marcus to export the KV mapping and confirm residency flags (done by today).
2) Kimberly to draft the SIG answers XLSX (today).
3) I'll assemble the PDF diagram and produce a one-page summary of purge guarantees and emergency snapshot process.

If Monday EOD is tight we can deliver the CSV + PDF first and follow with the XLSX. Confirm preferred order?

Cheers,
Ava Chen
Sr. Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Subject: SIG3 evidence delivery — KV map + segmentation diagram (attachments)
Attachments: redwood_ephemeral_kv_map.csv (text/csv), segmentation-diagram-v2.pdf (application/pdf), sig3-response-answers.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Hi Jill — per Ava's plan attached are the artifacts we discussed:

1) redwood_ephemeral_kv_map.csv — columns: provider, service_id, region, residency, key_scope (customer/tenant vs shared), last_review_date
2) segmentation-diagram-v2.pdf — logical diagram with notes on tenant isolation and telemetry flow
3) sig3-response-answers.xlsx — completed answers for the two SIG rows you flagged plus short contextual notes and links to our runbook.

High level clarifications:
- Ephemeral inference KV is per-tenant by default for hosted API requests; some internal caches are shared (e.g., model-metadata) and are marked residency=\"no-customer-data\" in the CSV.
- TTLs: default TTL for tenant KV = 72 hours; operationally the runtime aggressively evicts on LRU before TTL if memory pressure dictates.
- Snapshots: we do not take routine snapshots. On rare incident-driven snapshots we redact both token content and stable identifiers and require approvals (see runbook, link in sheet).

If you want us to redact additional fields in the CSV or narrow the region listing further let us know; happy to follow up with a short call.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Technical Program Manager, Security Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Jill Tran <jill.tran@novacare.com>

Date: 2026-11-22T16:28:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SIG3 evidence delivery — KV map + segmentation diagram (attachments)

Thanks Marcus — received the attachments and initial pass looks good. Two quick clarifications before we close the evidence item: 

1) In the CSV there are a couple of entries where residency is blank (provider=cache-ops-int). Can you confirm whether those are internal-only (no customer data) or tenant-facing?
2) On TTLs: you note a default 72-hour TTL but also LRU eviction — can you add a one-line sentence we can include in our control narrative that states the maximum guaranteed retention window (e.g., \"data retained no longer than 72 hours unless explicitly snapshot and approved by ops\").

If you can send a one-line confirmation for those two items by EOD Wednesday we'll mark the SIG rows as closed. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Jill
